questions.stem:
If the sum of first \(n\) natural numbers is \(\frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\), then what will be the sum of first \(n\) terms of the series of alternate positive and negative numbers when \(n\) is even? \(1^2 - 2^2 + 3^2 - 4^2 + 5^2 - \cdots\)

I. \(\frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\)

II. \(\frac{n^2(n + 1)}{2}\)

III. \(\frac{-n(n + 1)}{2}\)

Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
